title: CertDeliveryEnvelope
description: A signed CertREV certification credential. The signature is a detached Ed25519 signature over the RFC-8785 (JCS) canonicalization of `payload`. `payload.content` holds structured FACTS; the schema.org JSON-LD is projected from them at the render edge and is NOT part of the signed payload.

contractVersion.description: Envelope contract version. Bump on any breaking shape/signing-rule change.

certId.description: Stable CertREV certification id — idempotency key across pushes/reconciliations.

CertSubject.description: Stable identity binding. The signature covers all of this; copying the envelope to a different article (externalId mismatch) or editing reviewed content (contentDigest mismatch) is detected at the edge.

platform.description: Platform the envelope was minted for, e.g. 'shopify', 'wordpress', 'headless'.

externalId.description: Stable per-placement id on the platform (WP post id as string, Shopify Article GID).

logicalArticleId.description: CertREV's platform-independent article identity; survives migration/republish.

canonicalUrls.description: Every canonical public URL this credential may legitimately render on (primary + locale/slug variants).

installationId.description: App/connection install id that placed the credential; null when not applicable.

contentDigest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the canonicalized reviewed body — the anti-drift anchor. Null when content is not bound (edge then skips the drift check).

CertContent.description: Presentation-free certification FACTS. No HTML, no rendered JSON-LD — each edge renders + projects schema.org from these. `display` is OPTIONAL from v0.2 (presentation evicted to brand_render_defs; never-written by a v0.2 issuer, accepted-on-read from v0.1.x envelopes).

cardLabel.description: v0.2 (POR-9738): optional DISPLAY-only byline override; abbreviation stays the stable key.

complianceClass.description: v0.2 per-field compliance class stamped at mint (the reviewer credential is the canonical `gated` datum).

claimBearing.description: v0.2: does this field form a pre-click endorsement impression on the article face (pulls the compensation cue + scope line)?

bio.description: v0.2 (POR-9731): the reviewer's QA-VERIFIED short bio (contributors card).

background.description: v0.2 (POR-9731): the reviewer's QA-VERIFIED long background (profile modal body).

compensationCue.description: v0.2 (POR-10496 / POR-9731): first-class, pre-composed material-connection cue ('Compensated expert'); null for a pro-bono reviewer.

bio.description: v0.2 (POR-9731): author short bio (verified-only, contributors card).

memo.description: Expert first-person memo (plain text/markdown), or null.

certifiedAt.description: ISO-8601 — when the expert signed off.

contentModifiedAt.description: ISO-8601 latest content-version date, or null.

verifyUrl.description: Canonical public verification URL — the live source of truth.

articleTitle.description: v0.5 (POR-10481): the certified article's title (certificate modal 'Certifies the article' block). Optional + omit-when-undefined; wired onto the signed bytes in v0.5.

displayCertId.description: v0.5 (POR-10481): display-only pretty cert id (CR-YYYY-NNNN) for the modal meta row; a deterministic derivation of certId+year, not a second identity (verifyUrl is the real link).

CertDisplayConfig.description: Native theming inputs; all optional, edges fall back to theme defaults.

expiresAt.description: Hard stop; after this the edge renders nothing until a fresh envelope arrives.

revokedAt.description: ISO-8601 when revoked, else null. Non-null → fail closed.

revision.description: Monotonic per-placement revision; last-writer-wins at the edge.

CertSignature.description: Detached signature over canonicalize(payload). Does NOT cover itself.

alg.description: Ed25519 PureEdDSA — libsodium / WebCrypto / GCP KMS EC_SIGN_ED25519 compatible.

kid.description: Key id selecting the issuer public key. For the live root this is the GCP KMS cryptoKeyVersion resource name.

sig.description: base64url (unpadded) detached Ed25519 signature over the RFC-8785 canonical bytes of payload (raw 64-byte signature).
